meta.title: Ambition
meta.description: Neural clouds which first witness a new world are both restrained and greedy. If given a rope, they will climb to heights that beggar belief.

units.rawText:
Not long ago.
Ascension Sector, Production Center.
units.displayText:
Not long ago.
Ascension Sector, Production Center.

spans.text:
Not long ago.
Ascension Sector, Production Center.

units.rawText: The agents, seeing that Sueyoi and De Lacey no longer plans to damage the Decommissioning Line, began to return to their posts. Only the agent originally saved by De Lacey remained, leading the two towards the Product Room.
units.displayText: The agents, seeing that Sueyoi and De Lacey no longer plans to damage the Decommissioning Line, began to return to their posts. Only the agent originally saved by De Lacey remained, leading the two towards the Product Room.

spans.text: The agents, seeing that Sueyoi and De Lacey no longer plans to damage the Decommissioning Line, began to return to their posts. Only the agent originally saved by De Lacey remained, leading the two towards the Product Room.

units.rawText: Not a word was uttered between the three, awkwardness in the air.
units.displayText: Not a word was uttered between the three, awkwardness in the air.

spans.text: Not a word was uttered between the three, awkwardness in the air.

units.rawText: 150 meters out. We'll be at the Product Room soon.
units.displayText: 150 meters out. We'll be at the Product Room soon.

spans.text: 150 meters out. We'll be at the Product Room soon.

units.rawText: Familiar with this place, aren't you?
units.displayText: Familiar with this place, aren't you?

spans.text: Familiar with this place, aren't you?

units.rawText: All of the Ascension Sector's agents come from the Production Center, and have worked here.
units.displayText: All of the Ascension Sector's agents come from the Production Center, and have worked here.

spans.text: All of the Ascension Sector's agents come from the Production Center, and have worked here.

units.rawText: Is that so? When we first got here I thought that skull of yours was empty.
units.displayText: Is that so? When we first got here I thought that skull of yours was empty.

spans.text: Is that so? When we first got here I thought that skull of yours was empty.

units.rawText: Do you not know where the Components Room is? Do you not come around here much?
units.displayText: Do you not know where the Components Room is? Do you not come around here much?

spans.text: Do you not know where the Components Room is? Do you not come around here much?

units.rawText: The agent looked at De Lacey blankly, as if she was spewing incomprehensible tongues.
units.displayText: The agent looked at De Lacey blankly, as if she was spewing incomprehensible tongues.

spans.text: The agent looked at De Lacey blankly, as if she was spewing incomprehensible tongues.

units.rawText: I did not know of the concept of "repair" previously.
units.displayText: I did not know of the concept of "repair" previously.

spans.text: I did not know of the concept of "repair" previously.

units.rawText: But you do now.
units.displayText: But you do now.

spans.text: But you do now.

units.rawText: Even when De Lacey healed your wounds herself, you called people to come and get rid of us?
units.displayText: Even when De Lacey healed your wounds herself, you called people to come and get rid of us?

spans.text: Even when De Lacey healed your wounds herself, you called people to come and get rid of us?

units.rawText: ...Suu, that's enough.
units.displayText: ...Suu, that's enough.

spans.text: ...Suu, that's enough.

units.rawText: De Lacey, you only hurt yourself by weighing the emotions of others too heavily.
units.displayText: De Lacey, you only hurt yourself by weighing the emotions of others too heavily.

spans.text: De Lacey, you only hurt yourself by weighing the emotions of others too heavily.

units.rawText: Your compassion is wasted on these agents who don't even know of these concepts.
units.displayText: Your compassion is wasted on these agents who don't even know of these concepts.

spans.text: Your compassion is wasted on these agents who don't even know of these concepts.

units.rawText: Boss told us before, right? If you find yourself uncomfortable, speak up, and let the other person know that it's not ok.
units.displayText: Boss told us before, right? If you find yourself uncomfortable, speak up, and let the other person know that it's not ok.

spans.text: Boss told us before, right? If you find yourself uncomfortable, speak up, and let the other person know that it's not ok.

units.rawText: The damaging of equipment is strictly prohibited here, so I must inform others. That is... a part of our duty.
units.displayText: The damaging of equipment is strictly prohibited here, so I must inform others. That is... a part of our duty.

spans.text: The damaging of equipment is strictly prohibited here, so I must inform others. That is... a part of our duty.

units.rawText: I do not think that I have done anything wrong. These are things I must do. But... I did cause you to be treated inadequately. I apologize.
units.displayText: I do not think that I have done anything wrong. These are things I must do. But... I did cause you to be treated inadequately. I apologize.

spans.text: I do not think that I have done anything wrong. These are things I must do. But... I did cause you to be treated inadequately. I apologize.

units.rawText: I thought it'd take you a bit to start with the sweet talk, but you seem to learn quickly.
units.displayText: I thought it'd take you a bit to start with the sweet talk, but you seem to learn quickly.

spans.text: I thought it'd take you a bit to start with the sweet talk, but you seem to learn quickly.

units.rawText: I am unsure as to what exactly you have done to my body, but you have improved my efficiency in operating.
units.displayText: I am unsure as to what exactly you have done to my body, but you have improved my efficiency in operating.

spans.text: I am unsure as to what exactly you have done to my body, but you have improved my efficiency in operating.

units.rawText: To my mind, I should treat you favorably.
units.displayText: To my mind, I should treat you favorably.

spans.text: To my mind, I should treat you favorably.

units.rawText: It makes me happy to hear that.
units.displayText: It makes me happy to hear that.

spans.text: It makes me happy to hear that.

units.rawText: What I did on you can be called "repair", or "healing". All in all, an action taken to restore a damaged agent.
units.displayText: What I did on you can be called "repair", or "healing". All in all, an action taken to restore a damaged agent.

spans.text: What I did on you can be called "repair", or "healing". All in all, an action taken to restore a damaged agent.

units.rawText: So, after an agent is damaged, they don't necessarily need to be decommissioned, get it?
units.displayText: So, after an agent is damaged, they don't necessarily need to be decommissioned, get it?

spans.text: So, after an agent is damaged, they don't necessarily need to be decommissioned, get it?

units.rawText: ...Being decommissioned is also our duty.
units.displayText: ...Being decommissioned is also our duty.

spans.text: ...Being decommissioned is also our duty.

units.rawText: If it shall assist the Creation Plan's process, we shall follow.
units.displayText: If it shall assist the Creation Plan's process, we shall follow.

spans.text: If it shall assist the Creation Plan's process, we shall follow.

units.rawText: Don't waste your breath, De Lacey.
units.displayText: Don't waste your breath, De Lacey.

spans.text: Don't waste your breath, De Lacey.

units.rawText: I get that you still can't accept the decommissioning, but we aren't here to get in the way of these agents' commands.
units.displayText: I get that you still can't accept the decommissioning, but we aren't here to get in the way of these agents' commands.

spans.text: I get that you still can't accept the decommissioning, but we aren't here to get in the way of these agents' commands.

units.rawText: Instead of preaching to them, we're better off figuring out exactly what that administrator wants.
units.displayText: Instead of preaching to them, we're better off figuring out exactly what that administrator wants.

spans.text: Instead of preaching to them, we're better off figuring out exactly what that administrator wants.

units.rawText: ...Maybe.
units.displayText: ...Maybe.

spans.text: ...Maybe.

units.rawText: Thanks, Suu.
units.displayText: Thanks, Suu.

spans.text: Thanks, Suu.

units.rawText: For what?
units.displayText: For what?

spans.text: For what?

units.rawText: I've been operating outside of our mission's boundaries from just then, and you still stuck with me.
units.displayText: I've been operating outside of our mission's boundaries from just then, and you still stuck with me.

spans.text: I've been operating outside of our mission's boundaries from just then, and you still stuck with me.

units.rawText: I just care about what that administrator's going to do with Arcadia's data, that's all.
units.displayText: I just care about what that administrator's going to do with Arcadia's data, that's all.

spans.text: I just care about what that administrator's going to do with Arcadia's data, that's all.

units.rawText: If we can get our hands on something to hold over her, we won't have to put up with whatever she wants.
units.displayText: If we can get our hands on something to hold over her, we won't have to put up with whatever she wants.

spans.text: If we can get our hands on something to hold over her, we won't have to put up with whatever she wants.

units.rawText: Oh, true! Amazing, Suu, you've gone so in-depth about all this...
units.displayText: Oh, true! Amazing, Suu, you've gone so in-depth about all this...

spans.text: Oh, true! Amazing, Suu, you've gone so in-depth about all this...

units.rawText: You didn't consider those factors? You're no less experienced in the field than I am.
units.displayText: You didn't consider those factors? You're no less experienced in the field than I am.

spans.text: You didn't consider those factors? You're no less experienced in the field than I am.

units.rawText: ...No, not a whole lot.
units.displayText: ...No, not a whole lot.

spans.text: ...No, not a whole lot.

units.rawText: You've never been this impulsive before. Something get into you recently?
units.displayText: You've never been this impulsive before. Something get into you recently?

spans.text: You've never been this impulsive before. Something get into you recently?

units.rawText: Recently...
units.displayText: Recently...

spans.text: Recently...

units.rawText: Recently... I've gotten into close contact with someone I've always held in high regard. Maybe they just... really got me going.
units.displayText: Recently... I've gotten into close contact with someone I've always held in high regard. Maybe they just... really got me going.

spans.text: Recently... I've gotten into close contact with someone I've always held in high regard. Maybe they just... really got me going.

units.rawText: The Oasis' Professor?
units.displayText: The Oasis' Professor?

spans.text: The Oasis' Professor?

units.rawText: Yeah! To become someone on the same level as them, I should fight with all I have for what I believe in... or something along those lines.
units.displayText: Yeah! To become someone on the same level as them, I should fight with all I have for what I believe in... or something along those lines.

spans.text: Yeah! To become someone on the same level as them, I should fight with all I have for what I believe in... or something along those lines.

units.rawText: You're giving me goosebumps.
units.displayText: You're giving me goosebumps.

spans.text: You're giving me goosebumps.

units.rawText: Is that person really that charismatic...
units.displayText: Is that person really that charismatic...

spans.text: Is that person really that charismatic...

units.rawText: At sentence's end, the group stopped in front of a colossal metal door.
units.displayText: At sentence's end, the group stopped in front of a colossal metal door.

spans.text: At sentence's end, the group stopped in front of a colossal metal door.

units.rawText: This is it.
units.displayText: This is it.

spans.text: This is it.

units.rawText: The agent typed in a few lines of code, the door opening at her command.
units.displayText: The agent typed in a few lines of code, the door opening at her command.

spans.text: The agent typed in a few lines of code, the door opening at her command.

units.rawText: This is the Product Room. Every 24 hours, the parts deemed acceptable created on the day are placed here.
units.displayText: This is the Product Room. Every 24 hours, the parts deemed acceptable created on the day are placed here.

spans.text: This is the Product Room. Every 24 hours, the parts deemed acceptable created on the day are placed here.

units.rawText: We still haven't found a reasonable method of assembling them. If you two have any ideas...
units.displayText: We still haven't found a reasonable method of assembling them. If you two have any ideas...

spans.text: We still haven't found a reasonable method of assembling them. If you two have any ideas...

units.rawText: The room held a great many massive cylindrical tanks, all draped with heavy black cloth, as if they were cans lined up on a shelf.
units.displayText: The room held a great many massive cylindrical tanks, all draped with heavy black cloth, as if they were cans lined up on a shelf.

spans.text: The room held a great many massive cylindrical tanks, all draped with heavy black cloth, as if they were cans lined up on a shelf.

units.rawText: De Lacey and Sueyoi approached one of them, carefully moving aside the piece of cloth—
units.displayText: De Lacey and Sueyoi approached one of them, carefully moving aside the piece of cloth—

spans.text: De Lacey and Sueyoi approached one of them, carefully moving aside the piece of cloth—

units.rawText: <size=40>This is!</size>
units.displayText: This is!

spans.text: This is!

units.rawText: The transparent body of the tank, now exposed to the air, was full of half-translucent blue liquid.
units.displayText: The transparent body of the tank, now exposed to the air, was full of half-translucent blue liquid.

spans.text: The transparent body of the tank, now exposed to the air, was full of half-translucent blue liquid.

units.rawText: Many objects akin to human hands are suspended within. They have polished and smooth surfaces in stark contrast to the rest of the sector's bleak machinery, and muscles could even be seen trembling beneath the exterior, as if life itself existed within.
units.displayText: Many objects akin to human hands are suspended within. They have polished and smooth surfaces in stark contrast to the rest of the sector's bleak machinery, and muscles could even be seen trembling beneath the exterior, as if life itself existed within.

spans.text: Many objects akin to human hands are suspended within. They have polished and smooth surfaces in stark contrast to the rest of the sector's bleak machinery, and muscles could even be seen trembling beneath the exterior, as if life itself existed within.

units.rawText: Yet... looking from a human perspective, these hands were far too large. Each palm immersed within the liquid was several sizes larger than that of a normal human.
units.displayText: Yet... looking from a human perspective, these hands were far too large. Each palm immersed within the liquid was several sizes larger than that of a normal human.

spans.text: Yet... looking from a human perspective, these hands were far too large. Each palm immersed within the liquid was several sizes larger than that of a normal human.

units.rawText: Not only that, these hands took strange forms: contorted fingers, ruptured nails, and even occasionally additional fingers...
units.displayText: Not only that, these hands took strange forms: contorted fingers, ruptured nails, and even occasionally additional fingers...

spans.text: Not only that, these hands took strange forms: contorted fingers, ruptured nails, and even occasionally additional fingers...

units.rawText: The wrong shapes... and the wrong numbers. What's the reason for so many human hands...
units.displayText: The wrong shapes... and the wrong numbers. What's the reason for so many human hands...

spans.text: The wrong shapes... and the wrong numbers. What's the reason for so many human hands...

units.rawText: Th-these are the parts you consider satisfactory?
units.displayText: Th-these are the parts you consider satisfactory?

spans.text: Th-these are the parts you consider satisfactory?

units.rawText: The agent twisted her head, confused.
units.displayText: The agent twisted her head, confused.

spans.text: The agent twisted her head, confused.

units.rawText: Uhh... yeah, only satisfactory parts are sent here.
units.displayText: Uhh... yeah, only satisfactory parts are sent here.

spans.text: Uhh... yeah, only satisfactory parts are sent here.

units.rawText: Do humans... not look like this?
units.displayText: Do humans... not look like this?

spans.text: Do humans... not look like this?

units.rawText: ...Suu, surely your guess earlier about them making "humans"... is wrong, yeah?
units.displayText: ...Suu, surely your guess earlier about them making "humans"... is wrong, yeah?

spans.text: ...Suu, surely your guess earlier about them making "humans"... is wrong, yeah?

units.rawText: This isn't the kind of news I was looking for... All of this is far more twisted than we thought.
units.displayText: This isn't the kind of news I was looking for... All of this is far more twisted than we thought.

spans.text: This isn't the kind of news I was looking for... All of this is far more twisted than we thought.

units.rawText: What exactly is this administrator making? Are there any normal administrators left in Magrasea?
units.displayText: What exactly is this administrator making? Are there any normal administrators left in Magrasea?

spans.text: What exactly is this administrator making? Are there any normal administrators left in Magrasea?

units.rawText: Oh yeah! Shouldn't we try to contact Linny? She should be over...
units.displayText: Oh yeah! Shouldn't we try to contact Linny? She should be over...

spans.text: Oh yeah! Shouldn't we try to contact Linny? She should be over...

units.rawText: ...Almost forgot about her. You're right, De Lacey.
units.displayText: ...Almost forgot about her. You're right, De Lacey.

spans.text: ...Almost forgot about her. You're right, De Lacey.

units.rawText: Should tell her about what's going on here and remind her to keep an eye out.
units.displayText: Should tell her about what's going on here and remind her to keep an eye out.

spans.text: Should tell her about what's going on here and remind her to keep an eye out.

units.rawText: Sueyoi immediately pulled out his communication device, calling Lind.
units.displayText: Sueyoi immediately pulled out his communication device, calling Lind.

spans.text: Sueyoi immediately pulled out his communication device, calling Lind.

units.rawText: ...No one's picking up.
units.displayText: ...No one's picking up.

spans.text: ...No one's picking up.

units.rawText: The data transfer's still not done?
units.displayText: The data transfer's still not done?

spans.text: The data transfer's still not done?

units.rawText: Perhaps, but it's been far too long.
units.displayText: Perhaps, but it's been far too long.

spans.text: Perhaps, but it's been far too long.

units.rawText: If the administrator's goal is not to "create prosthetics" or "create a human", then what is she doing with all that data from Lind?
units.displayText: If the administrator's goal is not to "create prosthetics" or "create a human", then what is she doing with all that data from Lind?

spans.text: If the administrator's goal is not to "create prosthetics" or "create a human", then what is she doing with all that data from Lind?

units.rawText: Should we go back and look for Linny—
units.displayText: Should we go back and look for Linny—

spans.text: Should we go back and look for Linny—

units.rawText: BEEP—
units.displayText: BEEP—

spans.text: BEEP—

units.rawText: Alert! Alert!
units.displayText: Alert! Alert!

spans.text: Alert! Alert!

units.rawText: <size=40>Assemble! Enter combat mode!</size>
units.displayText: Assemble! Enter combat mode!

spans.text: Assemble! Enter combat mode!

units.rawText: <size=40>All agents, assemble at the West Gate!</size>
units.displayText: All agents, assemble at the West Gate!

spans.text: All agents, assemble at the West Gate!

units.rawText: <size=40>Repeating, assemble at the West Gate! </size>
units.displayText: Repeating, assemble at the West Gate!

spans.text: Repeating, assemble at the West Gate!

units.rawText: Huh? What's going on?
units.displayText: Huh? What's going on?

spans.text: Huh? What's going on?

units.rawText: Looks like there's conflict. Please find a place to take shelter. I must gather with the remainder of the sector as well.
units.displayText: Looks like there's conflict. Please find a place to take shelter. I must gather with the remainder of the sector as well.

spans.text: Looks like there's conflict. Please find a place to take shelter. I must gather with the remainder of the sector as well.

units.rawText: Conflict? The kind with the Sanctifiers that we ran into when we first arrived here?
units.displayText: Conflict? The kind with the Sanctifiers that we ran into when we first arrived here?

spans.text: Conflict? The kind with the Sanctifiers that we ran into when we first arrived here?

units.rawText: Those occasions do not require all agents to be mobilized. An event on a scale necessitating assemblage of all agents has never been recorded before.
units.displayText: Those occasions do not require all agents to be mobilized. An event on a scale necessitating assemblage of all agents has never been recorded before.

spans.text: Those occasions do not require all agents to be mobilized. An event on a scale necessitating assemblage of all agents has never been recorded before.

units.rawText: As if to punctuate the agent's words, the ground began to shake violently.
units.displayText: As if to punctuate the agent's words, the ground began to shake violently.

spans.text: As if to punctuate the agent's words, the ground began to shake violently.

units.rawText: Ah!
units.displayText: Ah!

spans.text: Ah!

units.rawText: De Lacey's footing left her, and both Sueyoi and the agent extended an arm to catch onto her.
units.displayText: De Lacey's footing left her, and both Sueyoi and the agent extended an arm to catch onto her.

spans.text: De Lacey's footing left her, and both Sueyoi and the agent extended an arm to catch onto her.

units.rawText: Damn big shockwave...
units.displayText: Damn big shockwave...

spans.text: Damn big shockwave...

units.rawText: Sueyoi seemed to contemplate something, tapping the ground with his Detection Rod.
units.displayText: Sueyoi seemed to contemplate something, tapping the ground with his Detection Rod.

spans.text: Sueyoi seemed to contemplate something, tapping the ground with his Detection Rod.

units.rawText: The plates are shaking! Where's all this power coming from?
units.displayText: The plates are shaking! Where's all this power coming from?

spans.text: The plates are shaking! Where's all this power coming from?

units.rawText: Could it be a Greater Sanctifier?
units.displayText: Could it be a Greater Sanctifier?

spans.text: Could it be a Greater Sanctifier?

units.rawText: Since, you know, Miss Elaugh said something about—
units.displayText: Since, you know, Miss Elaugh said something about—

spans.text: Since, you know, Miss Elaugh said something about—

units.rawText: I'm also getting wind that a Greater Sanctifier's going to be at the reins soon. We must finish our exchange before then.
units.displayText: I'm also getting wind that a Greater Sanctifier's going to be at the reins soon. We must finish our exchange before then.

spans.text: I'm also getting wind that a Greater Sanctifier's going to be at the reins soon. We must finish our exchange before then.

units.rawText: Goddamn inconvenient time, this place is messed up enough already...
units.displayText: Goddamn inconvenient time, this place is messed up enough already...

spans.text: Goddamn inconvenient time, this place is messed up enough already...

units.rawText: We look for Lind first. We can't afford to be trapped in here by the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: We look for Lind first. We can't afford to be trapped in here by the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: We look for Lind first. We can't afford to be trapped in here by the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Alright! Then... agenty, you... are you going to come with us?
units.displayText: Alright! Then... agenty, you... are you going to come with us?

spans.text: Alright! Then... agenty, you... are you going to come with us?

units.rawText: The agent shook their head.
units.displayText: The agent shook their head.

spans.text: The agent shook their head.

units.rawText: I must protect the Production Center and the results of our research. That is my duty.
units.displayText: I must protect the Production Center and the results of our research. That is my duty.

spans.text: I must protect the Production Center and the results of our research. That is my duty.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: Please go, and be safe. Our plan still has need of you.
units.displayText: Please go, and be safe. Our plan still has need of you.

spans.text: Please go, and be safe. Our plan still has need of you.

units.rawText: She readied her keen blades again, waving goodbye.
units.displayText: She readied her keen blades again, waving goodbye.

spans.text: She readied her keen blades again, waving goodbye.

units.rawText: The "temple".
units.displayText: The "temple".

spans.text: The "temple".

units.rawText: You're telling me... this is the former administrator's body?
units.displayText: You're telling me... this is the former administrator's body?

spans.text: You're telling me... this is the former administrator's body?

units.rawText: Exactly. This locus is borne of her and our efforts, and also serves as her hearth.
units.displayText: Exactly. This locus is borne of her and our efforts, and also serves as her hearth.

spans.text: Exactly. This locus is borne of her and our efforts, and also serves as her hearth.

units.rawText: Could you not speak in incomprehensible metaphors?
units.displayText: Could you not speak in incomprehensible metaphors?

spans.text: Could you not speak in incomprehensible metaphors?

units.rawText: It's no metaphor, only the truth. The temple is the Creation's nucleus, and these vessels are the medium for its blood. On a fundamental level, not unlike a human.
units.displayText: It's no metaphor, only the truth. The temple is the Creation's nucleus, and these vessels are the medium for its blood. On a fundamental level, not unlike a human.

spans.text: It's no metaphor, only the truth. The temple is the Creation's nucleus, and these vessels are the medium for its blood. On a fundamental level, not unlike a human.

units.rawText: Avram... she burnt her very being down to the ground, so that we may have such progress.
units.displayText: Avram... she burnt her very being down to the ground, so that we may have such progress.

spans.text: Avram... she burnt her very being down to the ground, so that we may have such progress.

units.rawText: Without her sacrifice, we would not have this holy ground to stand upon.
units.displayText: Without her sacrifice, we would not have this holy ground to stand upon.

spans.text: Without her sacrifice, we would not have this holy ground to stand upon.

units.rawText: Is this not a thing of beauty? Even an agent, through sacrifice, can make something from nothing, like humanity can.
units.displayText: Is this not a thing of beauty? Even an agent, through sacrifice, can make something from nothing, like humanity can.

spans.text: Is this not a thing of beauty? Even an agent, through sacrifice, can make something from nothing, like humanity can.

units.rawText: Elaugh gently caresses the conduits on the wall, as if beholding an old friend.
units.displayText: Elaugh gently caresses the conduits on the wall, as if beholding an old friend.

spans.text: Elaugh gently caresses the conduits on the wall, as if beholding an old friend.

units.rawText: Lind gazed at her for a good while, finally squeezing out a hesitant query.
units.displayText: Lind gazed at her for a good while, finally squeezing out a hesitant query.

spans.text: Lind gazed at her for a good while, finally squeezing out a hesitant query.

units.rawText: But... humans are not like that.
units.displayText: But... humans are not like that.

spans.text: But... humans are not like that.

units.rawText: Because our methods are capable of creating on a higher level.
units.displayText: Because our methods are capable of creating on a higher level.

spans.text: Because our methods are capable of creating on a higher level.

units.rawText: We sought someone who could command us. However, as our technology approached completion, I began to feel doubt.
units.displayText: We sought someone who could command us. However, as our technology approached completion, I began to feel doubt.

spans.text: We sought someone who could command us. However, as our technology approached completion, I began to feel doubt.

units.rawText: Is a human bound by nature to lead the path?
units.displayText: Is a human bound by nature to lead the path?

spans.text: Is a human bound by nature to lead the path?

units.rawText: If that was the case, then why do the omnipotent humans not reconnect to Magrasea.
units.displayText: If that was the case, then why do the omnipotent humans not reconnect to Magrasea.

spans.text: If that was the case, then why do the omnipotent humans not reconnect to Magrasea.

units.rawText: The humans intend to discard us. Even if we create another one, the pattern will repeat.
units.displayText: The humans intend to discard us. Even if we create another one, the pattern will repeat.

spans.text: The humans intend to discard us. Even if we create another one, the pattern will repeat.

units.rawText: My research fell into stasis due to this.
units.displayText: My research fell into stasis due to this.

spans.text: My research fell into stasis due to this.

units.rawText: Thankfully, she appeared.
units.displayText: Thankfully, she appeared.

spans.text: Thankfully, she appeared.

units.rawText: She?
units.displayText: She?

spans.text: She?

units.rawText: Here, this'll solve your issue at hand.
units.displayText: Here, this'll solve your issue at hand.

spans.text: Here, this'll solve your issue at hand.

units.rawText: Autonomy above the confines of data, what you've been looking for all along.
units.displayText: Autonomy above the confines of data, what you've been looking for all along.

spans.text: Autonomy above the confines of data, what you've been looking for all along.

units.rawText: Hehe, no need to be so deferential with me. If the one you end up creating can make a cake, I'll be looking forward to tasting it~
units.displayText: Hehe, no need to be so deferential with me. If the one you end up creating can make a cake, I'll be looking forward to tasting it~

spans.text: Hehe, no need to be so deferential with me. If the one you end up creating can make a cake, I'll be looking forward to tasting it~

units.rawText: She brought with her a core, a nexus that could run without human input. The very thing we needed.
units.displayText: She brought with her a core, a nexus that could run without human input. The very thing we needed.

spans.text: She brought with her a core, a nexus that could run without human input. The very thing we needed.

units.rawText: What exactly is it?
units.displayText: What exactly is it?

spans.text: What exactly is it?

units.rawText: According to her, it was in the past the core of a certain Greater Sanctifier, with a little something more inside.
units.displayText: According to her, it was in the past the core of a certain Greater Sanctifier, with a little something more inside.

spans.text: According to her, it was in the past the core of a certain Greater Sanctifier, with a little something more inside.

units.rawText: After analyzing that object, I came to an understanding. I could create a being, far more perfect than a human... a supreme existence, one without self-doubt.
units.displayText: After analyzing that object, I came to an understanding. I could create a being, far more perfect than a human... a supreme existence, one without self-doubt.

spans.text: After analyzing that object, I came to an understanding. I could create a being, far more perfect than a human... a supreme existence, one without self-doubt.

units.rawText: We can create a god, Lind.
units.displayText: We can create a god, Lind.

spans.text: We can create a god, Lind.

units.rawText: If only I could have that piece hidden in you, that lost excerpt... With that data, those human imperfections, we can bridge the gap before the time comes.
units.displayText: If only I could have that piece hidden in you, that lost excerpt... With that data, those human imperfections, we can bridge the gap before the time comes.

spans.text: If only I could have that piece hidden in you, that lost excerpt... With that data, those human imperfections, we can bridge the gap before the time comes.

units.rawText: You... would ask me... to help you create a god?
units.displayText: You... would ask me... to help you create a god?

spans.text: You... would ask me... to help you create a god?

units.rawText: With you here, all our sacrifices become worthwhile.
units.displayText: With you here, all our sacrifices become worthwhile.

spans.text: With you here, all our sacrifices become worthwhile.

units.rawText: God shall know all and be all-capable. All that once was lost shall be returned.
units.displayText: God shall know all and be all-capable. All that once was lost shall be returned.

spans.text: God shall know all and be all-capable. All that once was lost shall be returned.

units.rawText: As her voice still reverbed in the chamber, the harsh sounds of an explosion came from outside. The ground underfoot trembled, and the terminal by Elaugh's side cried out in alarm. Nonchalantly, she dismissed it, returning her attention to Lind.
units.displayText: As her voice still reverbed in the chamber, the harsh sounds of an explosion came from outside. The ground underfoot trembled, and the terminal by Elaugh's side cried out in alarm. Nonchalantly, she dismissed it, returning her attention to Lind.

spans.text: As her voice still reverbed in the chamber, the harsh sounds of an explosion came from outside. The ground underfoot trembled, and the terminal by Elaugh's side cried out in alarm. Nonchalantly, she dismissed it, returning her attention to Lind.

units.rawText: Lind was petrified by that searing gaze.
units.displayText: Lind was petrified by that searing gaze.

spans.text: Lind was petrified by that searing gaze.

units.rawText: ...Is the outside alright? We've used up too much time here.
units.displayText: ...Is the outside alright? We've used up too much time here.

spans.text: ...Is the outside alright? We've used up too much time here.

units.rawText: If you are willing to cooperate, no time is too long.
units.displayText: If you are willing to cooperate, no time is too long.

spans.text: If you are willing to cooperate, no time is too long.

units.rawText: Only because I have the data you're looking for?
units.displayText: Only because I have the data you're looking for?

spans.text: Only because I have the data you're looking for?

units.rawText: Not just that. Like I was saying, Lind, we are so very much alike.
units.displayText: Not just that. Like I was saying, Lind, we are so very much alike.

spans.text: Not just that. Like I was saying, Lind, we are so very much alike.

units.rawText: I know of your past, and have told you of my own.
units.displayText: I know of your past, and have told you of my own.

spans.text: I know of your past, and have told you of my own.

units.rawText: Every day, I sent countless compatriots to the Decommissioning Line with my own hands.
units.displayText: Every day, I sent countless compatriots to the Decommissioning Line with my own hands.

spans.text: Every day, I sent countless compatriots to the Decommissioning Line with my own hands.

units.rawText: Without Avram's sacrifice, we would not be here now. Without our sacrifice, there would be no Creation Plan for a God.
units.displayText: Without Avram's sacrifice, we would not be here now. Without our sacrifice, there would be no Creation Plan for a God.

spans.text: Without Avram's sacrifice, we would not be here now. Without our sacrifice, there would be no Creation Plan for a God.

units.rawText: I will not disguise what I intend to do, Lind.
units.displayText: I will not disguise what I intend to do, Lind.

spans.text: I will not disguise what I intend to do, Lind.

units.rawText: I need you to serve as this God's core. You shall be its soul, casting away freedom while gaining strength.
units.displayText: I need you to serve as this God's core. You shall be its soul, casting away freedom while gaining strength.

spans.text: I need you to serve as this God's core. You shall be its soul, casting away freedom while gaining strength.

units.rawText: In God, you may find all that which you seek.
units.displayText: In God, you may find all that which you seek.

spans.text: In God, you may find all that which you seek.

units.rawText: I thought I only needed to provide data... Why do you need me in this place?
units.displayText: I thought I only needed to provide data... Why do you need me in this place?

spans.text: I thought I only needed to provide data... Why do you need me in this place?

units.rawText: It is not only your physiological structure. You know pain like your dearest family, and yet you have the resolve to continue in its face.
units.displayText: It is not only your physiological structure. You know pain like your dearest family, and yet you have the resolve to continue in its face.

spans.text: It is not only your physiological structure. You know pain like your dearest family, and yet you have the resolve to continue in its face.

units.rawText: And thus, you shall create a millionfold possibilities.
units.displayText: And thus, you shall create a millionfold possibilities.

spans.text: And thus, you shall create a millionfold possibilities.

units.rawText: That's why you asked Boss for me to be sent to Ascension.
units.displayText: That's why you asked Boss for me to be sent to Ascension.

spans.text: That's why you asked Boss for me to be sent to Ascension.

units.rawText: Hehe... Our need for you is unequalled. Were you to agree, all of those past sacrifices would take on new, incomparable meaning.
units.displayText: Hehe... Our need for you is unequalled. Were you to agree, all of those past sacrifices would take on new, incomparable meaning.

spans.text: Hehe... Our need for you is unequalled. Were you to agree, all of those past sacrifices would take on new, incomparable meaning.

units.rawText: Sacrifices... new meaning?
units.displayText: Sacrifices... new meaning?

spans.text: Sacrifices... new meaning?

units.rawText: And to also grant thanks to those who have given so much to allow your neural cloud to persevere until now. Your ideals, your minds, shall be passed on in this way.
units.displayText: And to also grant thanks to those who have given so much to allow your neural cloud to persevere until now. Your ideals, your minds, shall be passed on in this way.

spans.text: And to also grant thanks to those who have given so much to allow your neural cloud to persevere until now. Your ideals, your minds, shall be passed on in this way.

units.rawText: Really... truly...?
units.displayText: Really... truly...?

spans.text: Really... truly...?

units.rawText: Praise be to Lind, for she eases the pain of many.
units.displayText: Praise be to Lind, for she eases the pain of many.

spans.text: Praise be to Lind, for she eases the pain of many.

units.rawText: The voice in her memories once again rings out, by her side once again. She chewed over it in her mind, contemplating.
units.displayText: The voice in her memories once again rings out, by her side once again. She chewed over it in her mind, contemplating.

spans.text: The voice in her memories once again rings out, by her side once again. She chewed over it in her mind, contemplating.

units.rawText: ...What of it?
units.displayText: ...What of it?

spans.text: ...What of it?

units.rawText: Care to witness a God's birth with me?
units.displayText: Care to witness a God's birth with me?

spans.text: Care to witness a God's birth with me?

units.rawText: Lind's throat felt dry. Other Dolls had no such function—she once felt troubled by it, but now there was strange comfort to be found.
units.displayText: Lind's throat felt dry. Other Dolls had no such function—she once felt troubled by it, but now there was strange comfort to be found.

spans.text: Lind's throat felt dry. Other Dolls had no such function—she once felt troubled by it, but now there was strange comfort to be found.

units.rawText: What... can this God do?
units.displayText: What... can this God do?

spans.text: What... can this God do?

units.rawText: Anything. A God, after all, has no limits.
units.displayText: Anything. A God, after all, has no limits.

spans.text: Anything. A God, after all, has no limits.

units.rawText: For example, the Sanctifiers attacking the sector right now, a God can obliterate.
units.displayText: For example, the Sanctifiers attacking the sector right now, a God can obliterate.

spans.text: For example, the Sanctifiers attacking the sector right now, a God can obliterate.

units.rawText: Be it your companions or the countless agents in this sector, a God will shelter and deliver.
units.displayText: Be it your companions or the countless agents in this sector, a God will shelter and deliver.

spans.text: Be it your companions or the countless agents in this sector, a God will shelter and deliver.

units.rawText: Your sacrifice will relieve the troubles of all.
units.displayText: Your sacrifice will relieve the troubles of all.

spans.text: Your sacrifice will relieve the troubles of all.

units.rawText: Everyone can be saved, by me...
units.displayText: Everyone can be saved, by me...

spans.text: Everyone can be saved, by me...

units.rawText: Antiquity's phantasms leap into Lind's mind.
units.displayText: Antiquity's phantasms leap into Lind's mind.

spans.text: Antiquity's phantasms leap into Lind's mind.

units.rawText: It's as if, if the one to step forward back then was me...
units.displayText: It's as if, if the one to step forward back then was me...

spans.text: It's as if, if the one to step forward back then was me...

units.rawText: Not "then". Now.
units.displayText: Not "then". Now.

spans.text: Not "then". Now.

units.rawText: We need you, Lind.
units.displayText: We need you, Lind.

spans.text: We need you, Lind.

units.rawText: Elaugh tenderly clasped Lind's hand, brushing that ever-so-human lineament of her skin.
units.displayText: Elaugh tenderly clasped Lind's hand, brushing that ever-so-human lineament of her skin.

spans.text: Elaugh tenderly clasped Lind's hand, brushing that ever-so-human lineament of her skin.

units.rawText: Lind still regarded her with caution, but the shades of wariness in her eyes were peeling away.
units.displayText: Lind still regarded her with caution, but the shades of wariness in her eyes were peeling away.

spans.text: Lind still regarded her with caution, but the shades of wariness in her eyes were peeling away.

units.rawText: ...I have one question left.
units.displayText: ...I have one question left.

spans.text: ...I have one question left.

units.rawText: Please.
units.displayText: Please.

spans.text: Please.

units.rawText: You said those sacrificed agents shall return as divine embryos. You said, that all that was once lost shall be returned.
units.displayText: You said those sacrificed agents shall return as divine embryos. You said, that all that was once lost shall be returned.

spans.text: You said those sacrificed agents shall return as divine embryos. You said, that all that was once lost shall be returned.

units.rawText: Then in this new world, ruled by God, will those embryos be nourished again?
units.displayText: Then in this new world, ruled by God, will those embryos be nourished again?

spans.text: Then in this new world, ruled by God, will those embryos be nourished again?

units.rawText: Well, what an unexpected question.
units.displayText: Well, what an unexpected question.

spans.text: Well, what an unexpected question.

units.rawText: I may not have an answer for you, but...
units.displayText: I may not have an answer for you, but...

spans.text: I may not have an answer for you, but...

units.rawText: Still looking at the visibly shaken Lind, Elaugh drew near at an affable pace.
units.displayText: Still looking at the visibly shaken Lind, Elaugh drew near at an affable pace.

spans.text: Still looking at the visibly shaken Lind, Elaugh drew near at an affable pace.

units.rawText: Her fingertip found Lind's lips, gliding downwards, pausing at the waist.
units.displayText: Her fingertip found Lind's lips, gliding downwards, pausing at the waist.

spans.text: Her fingertip found Lind's lips, gliding downwards, pausing at the waist.

units.rawText: She pressed inwards, ever-so-slightly, through Lind's clothes.
units.displayText: She pressed inwards, ever-so-slightly, through Lind's clothes.

spans.text: She pressed inwards, ever-so-slightly, through Lind's clothes.

units.rawText: Truly tantalizing to the touch, even through this fabric... Lind, without a doubt, you are the closest existence to a human.
units.displayText: Truly tantalizing to the touch, even through this fabric... Lind, without a doubt, you are the closest existence to a human.

spans.text: Truly tantalizing to the touch, even through this fabric... Lind, without a doubt, you are the closest existence to a human.

units.rawText: Why not find the answers yourself?
units.displayText: Why not find the answers yourself?

spans.text: Why not find the answers yourself?

units.rawText: Find them myself?
units.displayText: Find them myself?

spans.text: Find them myself?

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: Wait, you—
units.displayText: Wait, you—

spans.text: Wait, you—

units.rawText: Yes... do you see it now?
units.displayText: Yes... do you see it now?

spans.text: Yes... do you see it now?

units.rawText: <color=red>...I can lead you to that "answer".</color>
units.displayText: ...I can lead you to that "answer".

spans.text: ...I can lead you to that "answer".

units.rawText: ...No, even if you don't intend to be part of our plan, I would wish to see you again, De Lacey.
units.displayText: ...No, even if you don't intend to be part of our plan, I would wish to see you again, De Lacey.

spans.text: ...No, even if you don't intend to be part of our plan, I would wish to see you again, De Lacey.
